 Al Nassr v Al Qadsiah tickets, prices and kick-off details for Riyadh clash 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Al Nassr host Al Qadsiah at Al-Awwal Park, Riyadh, on Friday, 20 November 2026. Here is how to buy tickets, what they cost and the key match context.
 According to Goal.com, sales open via the club’s official ticketing platforms, with membership windows typically preceding general release. If primary allocations sell out, secondary marketplaces such as GrintaHub list resales.
 OneFootball Videos
 On official channels, general admission behind the goals usually ranges from SAR 30 to SAR 90. Mid and lower sideline seats are generally SAR 250 to SAR 600.
 VIP and hospitality options with lounge access typically start around SAR 500 and can exceed SAR 1,500, depending on package.
 On secondary platforms, shortside or upper tiers often start around SAR 180 to SAR 260. Longside lower tiers are roughly SAR 375 to SAR 940, with VIP lounges from about SAR 3,750 to SAR 5,200.
 Al Qadsiah won the last league meeting 3-1 on 3 May 2026, with Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat, Musab Al-Juwayr and Julián Quiñones scoring after João Félix’s effort for Al Nassr. Both sides have three wins from their last five, with Al Nassr beating Neftchi Fargona 3-1 in the AFC Champions League Elite after a 3-0 league win over Al Diriyah, while Al Qadsiah followed a 5-0 league victory over Al Kholood with a 1-1 draw against Pakhtakor Tashkent in the same competition. Al Nassr’s run also includes a 4-0 continental defeat to Al-Ain in September.
 Source: Goal.com
